scope_note: Eight assigned files only; data/backed/streaming/storage and exhaustive standard includes are separate reviews.
method: Full frozen-source inspection and historical-document grounding; no runtime, allocation, native-test or compiler timing claims.

findings.summary: Selected strings stage vector<string> before final packing and repeat shape work.
Dense owning copy duplicates the caller-buffer traversal with per-element checked arithmetic.
Sparse selected copy retains output-sized positions/indices plus duplicate-aware hash vectors.
Direct borrowed dense construction exposes detail dimensions; wrapper metadata still allocates.
Identity selection allocates before preserving or rediscovering the same mapping.
Focused record acquisition snapshots all field metadata and allocates temporary small-rank strides.
Interleaved record schemas and unused payload slots duplicate live metadata.
Interleaved copies unconditionally add a text allocation owner and an ownership wrapper.
Record field/row loops resolve dtype and flattened-coordinate work repeatedly.
Compiler overflow intrinsics and scalar ABI assumptions need declared portability qualification.

entries.name: anndatapp facade

costs: No runtime object or dispatch; expands public module dependency closure.

entries.name: anndatapp.core
entries.purpose: Core module re-exporting four interface partitions.
costs: No runtime object; imports arrays, strings, records and data without storage headers.

entries.name: Layout
entries.purpose: Dense, CSR or CSC physical organization.
costs: Small enum value; no allocation or dispatch until a caller branches on it.

entries.name: Validation
entries.purpose: Full boundary validation versus trusted input preconditions.
costs: Small enum value; no allocation or dispatch until a caller branches on it.

entries.name: ByteOrder
entries.purpose: Serialization preference distinct from native memory order.
costs: Small enum value; no allocation or dispatch until a caller branches on it.

entries.name: ErrorCode
entries.purpose: Typed diagnostics for arguments, layouts, encodings and I/O.
costs: Small enum value; no allocation or dispatch until a caller branches on it.

entries.name: NativeType
entries.purpose: Actual C++ scalar identity, preserving equal-width distinct native types.
costs: Small enum value; no allocation or dispatch until a caller branches on it.

entries.name: Error
entries.purpose: Exception with diagnostic code, logical path and runtime_error message.
costs: Owns path and base message strings; construction may allocate on error paths; no per-element state.

entries.name: Error operations: Error(code,path,message), code, path
entries.purpose: Construct and inspect typed diagnostics.
costs: Construction formats path and message; accessors return code/string reference without copies.

entries.name: Axis
entries.purpose: All/affine/gather positional map shared by arrays and metadata.
costs: Inline affine/all state; gathered positions use retained immutable vector; handle copies retain ownership; index is unchecked and branches by representation.

entries.name: Axis operations: Axis(), all, stride, gather(pointer,count), gather(initializer_list)
entries.purpose: Create shared selection maps with unsigned step magnitude and explicit reversal.
costs: All/stride allocate no positions; gather copies O(count) positions and retains their vector.

entries.name: Axis operations: is_all, is_gather, extent, index, first, step, reverse
entries.purpose: Inspect mapping and obtain unchecked source coordinate.
costs: Constant-time; index branches through all/gather/reverse cases, with unchecked coordinate arithmetic.

entries.name: detail::NativeType
entries.purpose: Alias to the public native scalar identity enum.
costs: No additional runtime representation.

entries.name: detail::LargeDimensions
entries.purpose: Overflow shape and signed-stride storage for arbitrary dense rank.
costs: Two owning metadata vectors and shared object/control block when acquired rank exceeds four.

entries.name: detail::DenseDimensions
entries.purpose: Inline rank-four dimensions with shared overflow metadata.
costs: Inline arrays avoid common-rank acquisition heap allocation; large-rank copies retain metadata; field lookup branches on overflow.

entries.name: detail::DenseDimensions operations: extent, stride
entries.purpose: Unchecked axis metadata reads.
costs: Constant-time inline/overflow branch; caller must supply valid axis.

entries.name: detail::DenseDimensions::inline_rank
entries.purpose: Common-rank inline capacity constant.
costs: Compile-time constant; determines descriptor footprint.

entries.name: detail::DenseDescriptor
entries.purpose: Retained erased dense acquisition packet.
costs: One shared State owner plus data, dimensions and contiguity; small rank avoids metadata allocation.

entries.name: detail::SparseDescriptor
entries.purpose: Retained erased sparse acquisition packet.
costs: One retained State plus three pointers, extents and structural writability flags; no numerical copies.

entries.name: detail::unsupported_dtype<T>
entries.purpose: Dependent false constant enabling unsupported-type static_assert.
costs: Compile-time constraint only.

entries.name: Numerical type mapping operations: detail::native_type_of<T>, dtype_of<T>, dtype_size
entries.purpose: Map C++ native identity and fixed-width logical dtype, and obtain scalar width.
costs: Templates compile away type branches; dtype_size is an out-of-line runtime switch; preserves aliasing identity.

entries.name: U in detail::native_type_of
entries.purpose: CV-stripped native scalar alias.
costs: Compile-time only.

entries.name: U in dtype_of
entries.purpose: CV-stripped logical scalar alias.
costs: Compile-time only.

entries.name: BorrowedDenseView<T>
entries.purpose: Typed dense descriptor without numerical allocation retention.
costs: Pointer plus copied DenseDimensions and contiguity; high-rank metadata can still be retained; no numerical ownership.

entries.name: BorrowedDenseView<T> operations: BorrowedDenseView(), BorrowedDenseView(pointer,detail_dimensions,contiguous)
entries.purpose: Construct direct borrowed view.
costs: No State allocation; public construction currently exposes detail metadata; inline metadata copies or overflow retention.

entries.name: BorrowedDenseView<T> operations: data, rank, extent, stride, contiguous, contiguous_data
entries.purpose: Expose pointer and checked dimension/contiguity access.
costs: data/rank/contiguous are direct; extent/stride check axis; contiguous_data throws on non-row-major layout; acquire outside numerical loops.

entries.name: DenseView<T>
entries.purpose: Retained typed direct dense access.
costs: Stores DenseDescriptor; copying retains State and possibly overflow metadata; element access uses returned pointer.

entries.name: DenseView<T> operations: DenseView(), DenseView(detail_descriptor)
entries.purpose: Construct retained acquisition result.
costs: Moves descriptor; retention cost occurs at acquisition/copy, not each element.

entries.name: DenseView<T> operations: data, rank, extent, stride, contiguous, contiguous_data, borrow
entries.purpose: Read dimensions/pointer and explicitly omit numerical retention.
costs: Extent/stride check axis; borrow copies inline/overflow dimension metadata while dropping allocation owner.

entries.name: DenseBytesView<Byte>
entries.purpose: Erased native dense bytes with byte strides for codecs/adapters.
costs: Retained DenseDescriptor plus scalar width; does not instantiate scalar-specific codec cross products.

entries.name: DenseBytesView<Byte> operations: DenseBytesView(), DenseBytesView(detail_descriptor,width), data, rank, extent, stride_bytes, element_size, contiguous
entries.purpose: Expose direct bytes and convert element strides to checked byte strides.
costs: No numerical copies; stride_bytes calls out-of-line checked multiplication; cache outside traversal.

entries.name: BorrowedSparseView<T,Index,Offset>
entries.purpose: Typed direct CSR/CSC pointers without retained numerical ownership.
costs: Three pointers, extents and writability flags; distinct index/offset types; no per-entry dispatch.

entries.name: BorrowedSparseView<T,Index,Offset> operations: BorrowedSparseView(), BorrowedSparseView(pointers,extents,writability), values, indices, offsets, rows, columns, nnz, unsafe_indices, unsafe_offsets
entries.purpose: Acquire direct structural pointers and explicit unsafe edits.
costs: Pointer access constant-time; unsafe structure access checks writability once and requires nonconst values template.

entries.name: SparseView<T,Index,Offset>
entries.purpose: Retained typed sparse direct access packet.
costs: SparseDescriptor retains State; returned pointers have no per-entry library work.

entries.name: SparseView<T,Index,Offset> operations: SparseView(), SparseView(detail_descriptor), values, indices, offsets, rows, columns, nnz, unsafe_indices, unsafe_offsets, borrow
entries.purpose: Inspect buffers, explicitly edit structure, or omit retention.
costs: Constant-time pointer/extents; structural writability checked at access; borrow drops State owner.

entries.name: SparseBytesView<Byte>
entries.purpose: Retained runtime-typed sparse bytes for implementation codecs and adapters.
costs: One descriptor and three widths; avoids value/index/offset template cross product; no scalar interpretation.

entries.name: SparseBytesView<Byte> operations: values, indices, offsets, rows, columns, nnz, value_size, index_size, offset_size, unsafe_indices, unsafe_offsets
entries.purpose: Expose buffers and widths, with explicit mutable structure access.
costs: Direct pointer/size reads; writability checks only for unsafe structure acquisition.

entries.name: SparseBytesView<Byte> operations: SparseBytesView(detail_descriptor,widths)
entries.purpose: Private acquisition constructor used by array/edit.
costs: Moves retained descriptor and stores scalar widths.

entries.name: ArrayView
entries.purpose: Read-only retained array binding plus optional lazy selection.
costs: Two shared_ptr handles; no payload copy; selection allocates mapping state; typed acquisition validates type/layout once.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: ArrayView(), rank, extent, dtype, layout, native_type, index_dtype, offset_dtype, serialization_byte_order, index_serialization_byte_order, offset_serialization_byte_order, index_native_type, offset_native_type
entries.purpose: Inspect array metadata and serialization hints.
costs: Most operations out-of-line with State/layout checks; extent uses selected mapping.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: select(pointer,rank), select(initializer_list)
entries.purpose: Capture composed lazy array axes.
costs: Allocates selection and axes even for identity; gather composition may copy coordinates.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: copy, copy_into
entries.purpose: Materialize independent storage or copy dense bytes into caller destination.
costs: Owning dense and caller-buffer transfer currently duplicate walkers; sparse selected copy stages output positions/indices; caller-buffer copy has no numerical destination allocation.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: bytes, sparse_bytes, dense<T>, unsafe_dense<T>, csr<T,Index,Offset>, csc<T,Index,Offset>
entries.purpose: Acquire retained direct memory descriptors.
costs: Dense mapping scans rank; affine gathers may scan selection to establish stridability; large rank allocates metadata; typed acquisition checks actual native identities except explicitly unsafe_dense.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: validate
entries.purpose: Explicit full source-storage validation.
costs: Dense checks rank/shape/address range; sparse scans stored offsets and indices, independent of lazy selection.

entries.name: ArrayView operations: ArrayView(state,selection), dense_descriptor, sparse_descriptor
entries.purpose: Private construction and operation-boundary descriptor validation.
costs: Retains State; dense computes origin/strides and contiguity, sparse rejects materialization-requiring selections.

entries.name: ArrayEdit
entries.purpose: Explicit mutable access to one retained array State.
costs: One shared State owner; creation enforces writable numerical storage; does not synchronize bytes.

entries.name: ArrayEdit operations: ArrayEdit(), view, bytes, sparse_bytes, dense<T>, unsafe_dense<T>, csr<T,Index,Offset>, csc<T,Index,Offset>
entries.purpose: Acquire mutable typed or byte buffers and a read-only binding.
costs: Descriptor acquisition performs boundary checks/retention; returned pointers have no per-element library work.

entries.name: ArrayEdit operations: ArrayEdit(state)
entries.purpose: Private retained edit construction.
costs: Shared State retention only; no numerical allocation.

entries.name: BufferDeleter
entries.purpose: C-style destruction callback with caller context.
costs: One function pointer; called once at final owned-buffer release, not per numerical element.

entries.name: Array
entries.purpose: Move-only dense or compressed-sparse owner/wrapper.
costs: One shared State handle; State retains independent numerical buffers; explicit copies only.

entries.name: Array operations: Array(), ~Array, Array(move), operator=(move), Array(copy)=delete, operator=(copy)=delete
entries.purpose: Move-only owner lifecycle.
costs: Moves transfer handle; final release destroys State and buffer ownership; no implicit deep copy.

entries.name: Array operations: empty<T>(initializer_list), zeros<T>(initializer_list), empty<T>(vector), zeros<T>(vector), csr<T,Index,Offset>, csc<T,Index,Offset>, from_sparse_buffers
entries.purpose: Allocate numerical storage or compose existing component ownership.
costs: Dense allocates State, shape/stride metadata and numerical buffer/control block; sparse allocates independent value/index/offset buffers; from_sparse_buffers retains components without copying bytes.

entries.name: Array operations: borrow_dense, share_dense, adopt_dense, borrow_sparse, share_sparse, adopt_sparse
entries.purpose: Wrap external bytes with borrowed, retained or callback-owned lifetime.
costs: State and metadata allocation; full sparse validation scans structure; trusted mode skips content validation; shares/adopts retain final release token.

entries.name: Array operations: rank, extent, dtype, serialization_byte_order, index_serialization_byte_order, offset_serialization_byte_order, layout, native_type, view, edit, copy, set_serialization_byte_order, set_index_serialization_byte_order, set_offset_serialization_byte_order, validate
entries.purpose: Inspect/edit bindings, control serialization hints, explicitly copy and validate.
costs: Most getters forward through temporary retained view; hints mutate shared State and need caller synchronization against readers; edit checks writable State; copy may allocate/traverse.

entries.name: Array operations: Array(state), allocate_dense, allocate_sparse, wrap_dense, wrap_sparse
entries.purpose: Private out-of-line allocation/wrapping boundary.
costs: Keeps allocation/validation out of public template bodies; creates move-only handle with retained State.

entries.name: detail::State
entries.purpose: Erased dense/sparse owner metadata and independent buffer lifetimes.
costs: One allocated State per wrapped/owned array; dense also reserves sparse fields; three ownership handles are needed for independent sparse components; vectors own shape/strides.
entries.rationale: Full tagged storage split is not justified without object-count/footprint and whole-code evidence; preserve independent sparse ownership.

entries.name: detail::Selection
entries.purpose: Immutable captured array-axis mappings.
costs: Allocated shared object plus vector<Axis>; affine mappings retain no position vectors.

entries.name: State local alias
entries.purpose: Short alias for detail::State.
costs: Compile-time notation only.

entries.name: ArraySelection local alias
entries.purpose: Disambiguate private array selection from high-level Selection.
costs: Compile-time notation only.

entries.name: Private helpers: detail::gather_axis, detail::compose_axis
entries.purpose: Own gathered coordinates and validate/compose mappings.
costs: Affine composition O(1); gather construction/composition O(count) with vector ownership; checked overflow uses compiler builtin.

entries.name: Private helpers: fail, require_state
entries.purpose: Central array diagnostics and empty/moved-from guards.
costs: Error-path string/exception work; pointer guard on boundary access.

entries.name: Private helpers: checked_mul, checked_byte_span, element_count, checked_signed_mul, checked_signed_add, signed_index, extent_stride, validate_dense_address_range, detail::checked_byte_stride
entries.purpose: Overflow-safe count, stride, addressability and byte conversion boundaries.
costs: Rank scans and checked arithmetic; compiler overflow builtins; owning copy repeats some checks per scalar.

entries.name: Private helpers: allocate_bytes, row_major_strides
entries.purpose: Allocate native numerical bytes and derive row-major strides.
costs: Numerical allocation plus shared control block; optional zero fill; metadata vector allocation and O(rank) setup.

entries.name: Private helpers: is_index_dtype, read_nonnegative<T>, read_index, write_checked<T>, write_index
entries.purpose: Interpret and range-check erased sparse structure.
costs: Runtime dtype switches per helper call; memcpy supports alias-safe scalar reads/writes; signedness and output-width checks.

entries.name: Private helpers: validate_state
entries.purpose: Full dense address and sparse structure validation.
costs: Dense O(rank); sparse O(major+nnz); boundary-only unless explicitly called.

entries.name: Private helpers: view_extent, original_index, has_selection, is_contiguous
entries.purpose: Resolve lazy extents/coordinates and direct-layout properties.
costs: Constant-time coordinate map; mapping/contiguity checks scan axes.

entries.name: Private helpers: check_component lambda
entries.purpose: Validate dense components before sparse ownership composition.
costs: Three component boundary checks; no numerical copy.

entries.name: Private helpers: transfer<Width> lambda
entries.purpose: Fixed-width dense copy_into coordinate/run transfer.
costs: Width dispatch once; per-output coordinate arithmetic; memcpy per scalar or contiguous trailing run.

entries.name: StringArrayView
entries.purpose: Retained packed UTF-8 binding with optional lazy axis selection.
costs: Two shared handles; scalar checked string access recomputes count/mapping; selected materialization stages strings.

entries.name: StringArrayView operations: StringArrayView(), rank, size, extent, shape, byte_size, storage_byte_size, string
entries.purpose: Inspect logical shape/text and packed size.
costs: shape allocates vector; selected byte_size traverses all values; string checks and unravels rank; scalar count/product recomputed.

entries.name: StringArrayView operations: storage_bytes, storage_offsets, bytes, offsets
entries.purpose: Expose original backing or require logically unselected packed storage.
costs: No payload copies; bytes/offsets reject selected logical arrays; storage pointers remain retained backing.

entries.name: StringArrayView operations: select(pointer,rank), select(initializer_list), copy, validate
entries.purpose: Capture selection, explicitly repack, and validate original storage.
costs: Selection allocates then may discard identity descriptor; selected copy creates vector<string> and repacks; validation scans offsets/UTF-8.

entries.name: StringArrayView operations: StringArrayView(impl,selection)
entries.purpose: Private retained binding construction.
costs: Two shared-handle moves; no numerical or text copy.

entries.name: StringArrayEdit
entries.purpose: Explicit mutable packed-byte/offset access.
costs: One retained impl; unsafe structural writes require later validation and caller synchronization.

entries.name: StringArrayEdit operations: StringArrayEdit(), size, byte_size, bytes, offsets, unsafe_offsets
entries.purpose: Acquire mutable packed buffers and dimensions.
costs: size scans rank; byte_size constant-time; writable pointer checks at acquisition; raw writes unchecked.

entries.name: StringArrayEdit operations: StringArrayEdit(impl)
entries.purpose: Private retained edit construction.
costs: One shared handle; no payload copies.

entries.name: StringBufferDeleter
entries.purpose: C callback releasing packed bytes and offsets together.
costs: One callback and context; invoked once on final adopted-buffer release.

entries.name: StringArray
entries.purpose: Move-only packed UTF-8 owner/wrapper with arbitrary outer shape.
costs: One retained impl; bytes/offsets may be moved, borrowed, externally shared or callback owned.

entries.name: StringArray operations: StringArray(), ~StringArray, StringArray(move), operator=(move), StringArray(copy)=delete, operator=(copy)=delete
entries.purpose: Move-only text ownership lifecycle.
costs: Move transfers handle; final release invokes appropriate owner; explicit copy only.

entries.name: StringArray operations: from_strings(vector), from_strings(initializer_list), from_packed
entries.purpose: Construct final packed storage from convenience strings or moved buffers.
costs: String paths copy into packed bytes; initializer-list path first owns each string; from_packed moves input vectors and retains one pair owner plus impl.

entries.name: StringArray operations: borrow_packed(const), borrow_packed(mutable), share_packed(const), share_packed(mutable), adopt_packed
entries.purpose: Wrap caller storage with explicit mutability/lifetime.
costs: Allocates impl and shape metadata; full UTF-8/offset validation unless trusted; adoption adds one paired owner; no text-buffer copy.

entries.name: StringArray operations: rank, size, extent, view, edit, copy, validate
entries.purpose: Inspect shape, acquire retained descriptors and explicitly copy/validate.
costs: Size scans rank; view retains metadata; edit checks writable; copy and validate traverse as documented.

entries.name: StringArray operations: StringArray(impl)
entries.purpose: Private owner construction.
costs: Moves one retained impl handle.

entries.name: detail::StringArrayImpl
entries.purpose: Packed storage metadata with one lifetime token.
costs: One allocated impl, shape vector, raw bytes/offsets and single erased owner; consolidated lifetime state already implemented historically.

entries.name: PackedBuffers
entries.purpose: One private owned pair for moved packed buffers.
costs: Two vector payloads under one shared object/control block; input allocation addresses unchanged.

entries.name: AdoptedBuffers
entries.purpose: Private RAII callback owner for separately allocated packed buffers.
costs: One shared object/control block; destructor invokes paired callback once.

entries.name: Private helpers: string_fail, element_count
entries.purpose: String diagnostics and addressable shape/offset count validation.
costs: Error-path strings; O(rank) count scans reused by checked scalar access.

entries.name: Private helpers: valid_utf8, continuation lambda
entries.purpose: Validate UTF-8 with bounded eight-byte ASCII prefix scan and scalar remainder decoder.
costs: Scans bytes; memcpy avoids alignment assumptions; no new runtime measurement; non-ASCII-heavy benefit unqualified.

entries.name: Private helpers: selected_extent, view_size, source_index
entries.purpose: Resolve selected dimensions and checked flat-to-source coordinates.
costs: O(rank) checked count and mixed-radix division for each selected scalar access.

entries.name: Private helpers: validate_impl
entries.purpose: Validate packed offsets, byte extent and per-string UTF-8.
costs: O(strings+bytes); reads caller buffers only under documented buffer-size/lifetime preconditions.

entries.name: Utf8Ref
entries.purpose: Native pointer-and-length UTF-8 member, with ownership held externally.
costs: Two scalar fields; no allocation; pointer rebinding transfers no ownership.

entries.name: RecordFieldKind
entries.purpose: Numeric, fieldwise packed text, inline fixed text or pointer-text member kind.
costs: Small enum; representation is chosen at operation boundary.

entries.name: RecordField
entries.purpose: Ordered field name, scalar kind/dtype, byte layout and serialization hint.
costs: Owns name string; copied with captured schema and duplicated currently in interleaved internal layout.

entries.name: RecordLayout
entries.purpose: Public explicit interleaved item size, alignment and field schema.
costs: Owns field vector/names; passed by value into constructors/conversions; returned metadata copy is explicit.

entries.name: detail::RecordDescriptor
entries.purpose: Retained pointer, byte dimensions and cached rank-one stride.
costs: Retains allocation/view owner; common dimensions inline; first_stride avoids per-element metadata lookup in member operator.

entries.name: Canonical record type mapping operations: detail::record_dtype<T>
entries.purpose: Require canonical fixed-width scalar member types.
costs: Compile-time type constraints; preserves native object identity.

entries.name: U in detail::record_dtype
entries.purpose: CV-stripped canonical field scalar alias.
costs: Compile-time only.

entries.name: RecordMemberView<T>
entries.purpose: Retained live native record-member access using byte strides.
costs: One retained RecordDescriptor; rank-one ptr/operator use cached first stride; flat_ptr unravels coordinates.

entries.name: RecordMemberView<T> operations: RecordMemberView(), RecordMemberView(detail_descriptor), data, rank, item_size, extent, stride_bytes, ptr, flat_ptr, operator[]
entries.purpose: Access first member, unchecked dimensions, rank-one members or explicit flattened coordinates.
costs: No per-row type dispatch/locks/allocation; ptr does byte arithmetic and launder; flat_ptr O(rank) division/modulo; extent/stride axis preconditions unchecked.

entries.name: Byte in RecordMemberView::ptr
entries.purpose: Const-correct byte pointer type for member address arithmetic.
costs: Compile-time only; no reinterpretation of records as a T array.

entries.name: Byte in RecordMemberView::flat_ptr
entries.purpose: Const-correct byte pointer type for flattened member address.
costs: Compile-time only.

entries.name: RecordTextView
entries.purpose: Focused text-field index under a retained captured record view.
costs: One shared full-view owner plus field index; checked string access computes count and row offset.

entries.name: RecordTextView operations: RecordTextView(), size, string
entries.purpose: Checked scalar text access after one field-name lookup.
costs: size scans rank; string checks count then resolves fieldwise/fixed/ref bytes; no string allocation.

entries.name: RecordTextView operations: RecordTextView(view,field_index)
entries.purpose: Private captured text-field construction.
costs: Retains existing view; no new schema copy.

entries.name: RecordArrayView
entries.purpose: Retained captured field bindings, schema and interleaved layout.
costs: One shared View owner; owner.view() creates whole schema snapshot; individual accesses resolve names linearly.

entries.name: RecordArrayView operations: RecordArrayView(), interleaved, rank, size, extent, shape, n_fields, field_names, field, record_layout
entries.purpose: Inspect physical representation, dimensions and schema.
costs: Size scans rank; shape/field_names/field/record_layout return owned metadata copies; names lookup linear.

entries.name: RecordArrayView operations: array, string_array, numeric_bytes, record_bytes, text, string, member<T>
entries.purpose: Acquire retained direct field/numerical/text access without implicit materialization.
costs: Fieldwise array/string return captured views; interleaved incompatible paths reject; names linear; fieldwise numerical descriptor currently allocates temporary strides.

entries.name: RecordArrayView operations: copy_array, copy_strings, copy_fields, copy_interleaved, copy, validate
entries.purpose: Explicit scalar-field/conversion/deep-copy and validation operations.
costs: Whole validation may scan schema/content; numeric copies flatten per scalar; string copies grow packed bytes; interleaving owns stable text arena and currently adds unnecessary empty owner layers.

entries.name: RecordArrayView operations: RecordArrayView(impl), member_descriptor
entries.purpose: Private captured construction and canonical field lookup/descriptor checks.
costs: Retains view; type/layout checks once; no dispatch in acquired numeric row loop.

entries.name: RecordArray
entries.purpose: Move-only fieldwise/interleaved record owner with explicit external-memory and copy contracts.
costs: One retained RecordImpl; view snapshots schema; numerical and text object lifetimes deliberate.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: RecordArray(), ~RecordArray, RecordArray(move), operator=(move), RecordArray(copy)=delete, operator=(copy)=delete
entries.purpose: Move-only record ownership lifecycle.
costs: Move handle only; final release frees field buffers or interleaved owner.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: with_shape, empty_interleaved
entries.purpose: Create fieldwise shape or aligned native member storage.
costs: Shape validation; interleaved aligned allocation plus per-field member object initialization; numeric dispatch currently inside row loop.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: borrow_interleaved(mutable), borrow_interleaved(const), share_interleaved(mutable), share_interleaved(const), adopt_interleaved
entries.purpose: Wrap live native members with explicit ownership, mutability, byte strides and alignment.
costs: Layout/address checks remain even in trusted mode; full validation additionally scans content; share/adopt retain caller record and pointed-text lifetime.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: set(numeric), set(strings), erase, set_field_serialization_byte_order
entries.purpose: Mutate fieldwise bindings or serialization hints.
costs: Name lookup linear; validates shape/native type; numeric set builds temporary single-field view; byte-order edit currently updates duplicated interleaved schema.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: view, copy, copy_fields, copy_interleaved
entries.purpose: Capture schema or explicitly duplicate/convert payload.
costs: View costs scale with all fields; copies allocate final payload and may validate/transcode; no hidden copy in member access.

entries.purpose: Explicit field/pointer/record-byte editing and full validation.
costs: Direct field edits linear lookup; edit_member uses full schema view; unsafe refs transfer no ownership; validation snapshots then scans.

entries.name: RecordArray operations: RecordArray(impl), wrap, edit_descriptor
entries.purpose: Private ownership/layout construction and mutable descriptor boundary.
costs: Wrap validates layout/addressability, stores duplicated schema; edit_descriptor snapshots schema after writable check.

entries.purpose: Fieldwise payload owner with numerical or packed-string alternative.
costs: Owns RecordField and two optional owner slots; interleaved entries use neither payload.

entries.name: detail::RecordFieldView
entries.purpose: Captured field schema and read-only payload binding.
costs: Owns RecordField name and both array/string-view slots; unused alternatives occupy state.

entries.name: detail::RecordImpl
entries.purpose: Fieldwise/interleaved record metadata and retained native memory owner.
costs: Allocated shared impl; shape/stride/field vectors; interleaved schema duplicated in layout and fields.

entries.name: detail::RecordViewImpl
entries.purpose: Immutable captured record bindings and physical metadata.
costs: Allocated shared full snapshot; copies shape/layout/strides/field names and retains each field owner.

costs: Additional shared object/control block plus two retained tokens even when no text bytes exist.

entries.name: Private helpers: fail, require
entries.purpose: Record diagnostics and empty-view boundary guards.
costs: Error-path owned strings; boundary pointer checks.

entries.name: Private helpers: mul, add, count
entries.purpose: Bound record shape/byte counts by addressable ptrdiff_t range.
costs: O(rank) count and checked scalar arithmetic.

entries.name: Private helpers: visit_numeric
entries.purpose: Select canonical numerical field implementation.
costs: Runtime switch selects template specialization; placement-new loop currently re-enters it for every row.

entries.name: Private helpers: utf8, check_name
entries.purpose: Validate UTF-8 text and schema names without NUL.
costs: Byte scans; scalar UTF-8 implementation separate from packed-string ASCII-prefix validator; no correctness difference established.

entries.name: Private helpers: find, width, alignment
entries.purpose: Resolve ordered field index and physical member width/alignment.
costs: Linear name lookup; kind/dtype dispatch for invariant schema facts; retain outside hot loops.

entries.name: Private helpers: check_layout, contiguous_strides, check_buffer
entries.purpose: Validate ordered nonoverlapping native layout and complete reachable address span.
costs: Pairwise field overlap/name checks O(fields^2); shape/stride checks O(rank); compiler overflow builtins.

entries.name: Private helpers: descriptor, numeric_descriptor
entries.purpose: Build retained inline/overflow byte-stride member descriptors.
costs: Common rank inline; large rank metadata allocations; fieldwise path temporarily allocates stride vector.

entries.name: Private helpers: offset, text_at
entries.purpose: Resolve flat record/text coordinates and fixed/ref text bytes.
costs: O(rank) division/remainder; fixed text trims trailing padding; ref text checks pointer-length representability.

entries.name: Private helpers: validate_view
entries.purpose: Check schema/layout/native identities and optionally all numeric/text contents.
costs: Schema O(fields^2), dimensions and content traversal; copies layout for validation; boolean bytes checked without invalid bool loads.
